fixes.fix: Merged 52 overlapping subtopics into correct categories
Add explicit Next button to homepage quiz flow
fixes.detail: Browser test shows ‘flow-skipped on Homepage — no visible Next button’ (19/22 pages passed but quiz flow not exercised).
fixes.text: Insert a clearly styled Next button element after each question container in the homepage HTML/JS, and update the quiz‑flow script to listen for its click event to advance to the next question. Ensure the button is always rendered even when JavaScript is delayed.

fixes.fix: Retry and log on‑demand lane failures for lyrics and tts
fixes.detail: Recent on‑demand failures: lyrics payload JSON errors (2) and tts edge‑tts errors (2) indicate transient or formatting issues.
fixes.text: Wrap the lyrics and tts generation steps in a retry loop (max 2 attempts) and capture the raw payload/error to a log file in data/failed‑on‑demand/*.json. Add a simple GitHub Action step that re‑runs failed jobs automatically on the next workflow run.

fixes.fix: Expose inventory of invented‑pool difficulty levels on mains page
fixes.detail: Invented pool holds 412 questions with a detailed difficulty breakdown, but mains page only shows 19 hand‑authored + 45 AI‑batch items.
fixes.text: Create a collapsible summary widget on the mains page that reads mental.html’s JSON and displays counts per difficulty (easy, moderate, hard, veryhard). Link each count to a filtered view of those questions, making the large pool discoverable without altering existing content.

fixes.fix: Automate daily wiki fill pipeline restart on stall
fixes.detail: Fault board notes ‘Corpus fill run in progress — daily-wiki-fill #700, #699’, suggesting the pipeline may be stuck.
fixes.text: Add a GitHub Action step that checks the status of the daily‑wiki‑fill workflow; if it remains running beyond a threshold (e.g., 2 hours), cancel and re‑trigger it. Log the action in the workflow run summary.

fixes.fix: Add sanity check for on‑demand JSON payloads before processing
fixes.detail: Multiple on‑demand failures stem from malformed JSON payloads (lyrics lane).
fixes.text: Before invoking the model, validate the incoming payload with a lightweight JSON schema (required fields: prompt, type). Reject and record malformed inputs, returning a user‑friendly error message instead of crashing the lane.
